description: Reorganize the redis-client repository to eliminate duplicate files between root and hask-redis-mux/, consolidate Docker directories, and improve project clarity for new contributors.

userStories.title: Remove redundant root data/ directory
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want a single canonical location for reference data so that I know where to update it.
acceptanceCriteria: cabal build all succeeds with no missing file errors
userStories.notes: The root data/cluster_slot_mapping.txt is an exact duplicate of hask-redis-mux/data/cluster_slot_mapping.txt. Only the hask-redis-mux copy is used (via embedFile in SlotMapping.hs).

userStories.title: Deduplicate lib/ by updating hask-redis-mux.cabal hs-source-dirs
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want library source code to exist in exactly one location so that changes are never inconsistent.
acceptanceCriteria: hask-redis-mux.cabal hs-source-dirs for all internal libraries (resp, client, crc16, redis-command-client, cluster, redis) point to ../lib/ instead of lib/
hask-redis-mux.cabal c-sources for crc16 points to ../lib/crc16/crc16.c
userStories.notes: The root lib/ and hask-redis-mux/lib/ contain identical source files. After this change, root lib/ is the single source of truth. Verify cabal supports ../ relative paths in hs-source-dirs within a cabal.project multi-package setup.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate unit test files from root test/
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want each test file to exist in only one place so that test changes are never lost.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test files that belong to hask-redis-mux (Spec.hs, ClusterSpec.hs, ClusterCommandSpec.hs, MultiplexerSpec.hs, FromRespSpec.hs, MultiplexPoolSpec.hs) are removed from root test/ only if they are duplicates of hask-redis-mux/test/ versions
E2E test files (E2E.hs, ClusterE2E.hs, LibraryE2E.hs, E2EHelpers.hs, ClusterE2E/, LibraryE2E/) remain in root test/
FillHelpersSpec.hs remains in root test/ (belongs to redis-client)
redis-client.cabal test and executable components still resolve all their source files
userStories.notes: Root test/ has copies of unit test files that are owned by hask-redis-mux. Only remove files that are exact duplicates AND are not referenced by redis-client.cabal. Check redis-client.cabal hs-source-dirs carefully before removing.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate E2E test files from hask-redis-mux/test/
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want E2E tests to exist only in the redis-client package where they belong.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E files in hask-redis-mux/test/ (E2E.hs, ClusterE2E.hs, LibraryE2E.hs, and any ClusterE2E/ or LibraryE2E/ subdirectories) are removed
hask-redis-mux.cabal does not reference any E2E files (verify no test-suite or executable uses them)
userStories.notes: E2E tests are defined as executables in redis-client.cabal, not hask-redis-mux.cabal. The copies in hask-redis-mux/test/ are unused duplicates.

userStories.title: Consolidate Docker directories under docker/
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want all Docker infrastructure grouped under one parent directory so it's easy to find.
acceptanceCriteria: git mv is used to preserve file history
userStories.notes: This story only moves the directories. Path reference updates happen in subsequent stories. Use git mv for history preservation.

userStories.title: Update Makefile Docker path references
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want the Makefile to work after Docker directories are reorganized.
acceptanceCriteria: All Makefile references to docker/ (standalone), docker-cluster/, and docker-cluster-host/ are updated to docker/standalone/, docker/cluster/, docker/cluster-host/
make targets that invoke docker-compose still work (dry-run or syntax check if Docker unavailable)
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005 completing the directory moves first.

userStories.title: Update scripts and Nix Docker path references
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want all scripts and Nix configs to reference the correct Docker paths.
acceptanceCriteria: All scripts in scripts/ that reference docker-cluster/ or docker-cluster-host/ are updated
All Nix files in nix/ that reference docker paths are updated
Any .github/ workflow files referencing docker paths are updated
Any references in flake.nix or default.nix to docker paths are updated
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005. Search all files for old docker path strings to ensure nothing is missed.

userStories.title: Verify full build and test pipeline
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want confidence that the reorganization didn't break anything.
acceptanceCriteria: nix-build succeeds (if network available; otherwise cabal build is sufficient)
make test succeeds (if Docker and network available)
No profiling artifacts or temp files are left behind
userStories.notes: Final verification story. Run the full build and test pipeline to confirm nothing is broken.
